examples.english: Strike while the iron is hot.
examples.notes: Proverb meaning: act while conditions are favorable.

examples.japanese: {鉄|てつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{橋|はし}→橋：02163_hashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{架|か}かっている→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{通勤|つうきん}している→通勤：03512_tsuukin⟧。
⟦{鉄道|てつどう}→鉄道：03550_tetsudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}する→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

notes:
{鉄|てつ} refers to iron as a material, and by extension, steel and iron products.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{鉄道|てつどう}→鉄道：03550_tetsudou⟧: railroad, railway
- ⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧: subway
- ⟦{鉄板|てっぱん}→鉄板：14470_teppan⟧: iron plate, griddle; also slang for "guaranteed"
- ⟦{鉄砲|てっぽう}→鉄砲：04540_teppou⟧: gun, firearm
- ⟦{鉄橋|てっきょう}→鉄橋：15430_tekkyou⟧: iron bridge
